name: M6.ActualCounts.finite_image_weighted_sum
statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [Fintype α] (L : α → β) (k : ℕ), (∀ a₀ : α, Nat.card {a : α // L a = L a₀} = k) → ∀ w : β → Polynomial ℤ, (∑ a, w (L a)) = Polynomial.C (k : ℤ) * ∑ b ∈ M6.ActualCounts.imageWords L, w b
queries: finite image sum subtype sum polynomial
guidance: Restrict codomain to the actual finite imageWords L. Every image point has a preimage, so the hypothesis identifies every fiber.card with k. Apply accepted FiberSum.uniform_weighted_sum on the finite image subtype, then rewrite its subtype sum as the finite image sum. No positivity/surjectivity assumption on arbitrary β; image restriction supplies actual surjectivity. Return tactic lines only, without leading by; preserve exact assumptions and target.
